title: ProjectionPublishStatusV1
description: Read-only result of `archctx projection publish-status`: the projection writer state for one (remote, base), shared by every checkout of the repository. Consumers detect it through the projection-publish-v1 capability.

branch.description: The rolling branch of the last locked run, or null before the first.

worktreePath.description: The writer-owned worktree; run `codegraph init <worktreePath>` once when code facts are required.

lastProcessedSha.description: The last base tip a run evaluated.

lastSuccessfulSha.description: The last base tip a run published or found up to date.
